directAnswer: Bluetooth 5.4 can maintain a connection for several hours to days, depending on device usage and battery capacity.
summary: The longevity of Bluetooth 5.4 connections varies based on device settings and battery life.

sections.heading: Battery Usage
sections.body: Bluetooth 5.4 is designed for low energy consumption, which helps extend battery life. However, active usage, such as streaming audio, can drain the battery faster.

sections.heading: Device Compatibility
sections.body: The actual duration of Bluetooth 5.4 connections can vary significantly between devices due to differences in hardware and software optimizations.

steps.title: Check Battery Settings
steps.detail: On your device, navigate to Settings > Battery to view the estimated battery life while using Bluetooth.

steps.title: Monitor Bluetooth Usage
steps.detail: Use your device's Bluetooth settings to monitor which devices are connected and their battery consumption.

faqs.question: Can Bluetooth 5.4 connect to older Bluetooth versions?
faqs.answer: Yes, Bluetooth 5.4 is backward compatible with older Bluetooth versions.

faqs.question: What factors affect Bluetooth connection duration?
faqs.answer: Factors include device battery capacity, usage patterns, and environmental interference.

faqs.question: Is Bluetooth 5.4 better than previous versions?
faqs.answer: Bluetooth 5.4 offers improvements in energy efficiency and range compared to previous versions.

caveats: Actual connection duration may vary based on device settings and environmental factors.
High data transfer rates can lead to faster battery drain.
